text:
Maya: Quick sync 11 postmortem finished. Need owners for external comms + a quick check if this matches any recurring cache/scale patterns.
Kevin: I can own the status page blurb. Will draft short note by EOD. Do we have a compact timeline to reference?
Raj: Timeline is in the doc. TL;DR pasted below for the blurb.
Raj: - 11:23 UTC: spike in inference latency observed (autoscaler delayed)
- 11:51 UTC: mitigation applied (routing change + manual scale)
- 12:10 UTC: recovered, normal traffic
Root cause: race in scale-up + cache warm path under bursty traffic.
Emily: Ill take the 72h customer note. Plan: 3 paragraphs (what happened, who was affected, what we did + next steps). Should we link to a redacted RCA or only a summary?
Maya: Recommendation: publish a redacted public summary and offer the full RCA to enterprise customers/support on request. Keeps transparency without exposing sensitive internals.
Kevin: Draft statuspage text suggestion: "We experienced intermittent inference latency impacting a subset of API requests between ~11:2312:10 UTC. Mitigations were applied and normal service resumed at ~12:10 UTC. A follow-up customer note with investigation details will be available within 72 hours." Short and factual, links to the 72h note. Thoughts?
Emily: Sounds good. For the 72h note Ill include impact metrics (% of requests affected), mitigation steps, temporary workarounds, remediation plan, and owners+ETAs.
Incident Bot: Reminder: add owner tags to postmortem actions: /assign @Emily external note, /assign @Kevin statuspage, /assign @Raj timeline artifacts.
Maya: Final action items: 1) Status page blurb (Kevin)  draft by 2024-06-14 17:00 UTC. 2) 72h customer note (Emily)  first draft by 2024-06-15 16:00 UTC, final by 2024-06-17 16:00 UTC. 3) Sanitized timeline + artifacts (Raj)  push by 2024-06-14 20:00 UTC. 4) RCA sharing policy (Maya)  finalize wording (redacted public summary + full on request) by 2024-06-15 12:00 UTC. 5) Recurring-patterns check (Raj + SRE)  short report by 2024-06-18.
Kevin: :thumbsup: Ill post the statuspage draft in 30m and link to Emilys note when ready. Also: include a simple mitigation line for customers: "We deployed a fix to improve autoscaling responsiveness and cache warm paths." Keep it high-level.
Emily: Noted. Ill add a brief FAQ snippet for expected customer questions (retries, rate limits, enterprise escalation).
Maya: Once the note and links are live, well update the statuspage and close the follow-ups. If ETAs slip, update the postmortem status.
Incident Bot: Actions recorded: 5 owners assigned. Please update ETAs in the postmortem doc if anything changes.
